title: Gene expression analysis for browning in murine fat tissues and liver fibrosis.
author: Bianca Hemmeryckx
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kbgcsjw
materials: Make sure portion sizes of murine tissues are appropriate for the amount of RNA the RNAeasy column (RNAeasy kit) can hold: -sWAT: 100 mg -GON WAT: 100 mg -Liver: 30 mg RNAeasy mini kit Qiagen Catalog #74106
Use a new tube to collect flow-through.

Make complementary DNA from the total RNA samples using the Taqman Reverse Transcription Reagents: per sample combine 5.725µl RNAse-free water, 2.5µl 10x RT buffer (1x), 5.5µl MgCl2 solution, 4µl dNTPs mixture (2.5 mM each), 1.25µl 50 µM random hexamers (2.5 µM), 0.4µl 20U/µl RNAse inhibitors (0.32U/µl), 0.625µl 50U/µl Multiscribe enzyme (1.25U/µl) with 5µl 10 ng/µl total RNA. Taqman reverse transcription reagents Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #N8080234 Multiscribe reverse transcriptase Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #N8080018 Random hexamers Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #N8080127 Multiply µStrip 0.2 ml chain Contributed by users Catalog #72.985.002

cDNA samples are applied in duplicate on the 96 well fast thermal cycling plate for each gene * Thermo Fisher Scientific ref. 4366932 Optical 96 well fast thermal cycling plates, 200 pcs Optical 96 well fast thermal cycling plates Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #4366932
Cover plates with optical adhesive cover. Press cover firmly on plate. ABI prism optical adhesive covers Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #4311971
Allow plate to warm-up to room temperature.
Before running, centrifuge plates quickly at room temperature in a table-top centrifuge Sigma 4.15C (Qiagen)

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl RLT buffer (from the RNAeasy kit) containing β‑mercaptoethanol (Merck MilliporeSigma, Catalog #M3148‑25ML) to each labeled 2 ml Lysing matrix D tube (MP Biomedicals, Catalog #6913100). Keep tubes on regular ice.

steps.title: Transfer tissues to tubes
steps.instruction: Using ethanol‑swapped forceps, transfer each tissue sample into its corresponding labeled Lysing matrix D tube on ice.

steps.title: First homogenization
steps.instruction: Place tubes in the FastPrep‑24 (MP Biomedicals) and homogenize at speed 6 for 40 seconds. Follow the instrument procedure: push the back button, remove the first platform, place tubes on the second platform, engage the head, set speed, run, then return the platform to ice.

steps.title: Second homogenization
steps.instruction: Homogenize the same samples a second time at speed 4 for 40 seconds. Return tubes to ice after the run.

steps.title: Centrifuge homogenate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenized samples at room temperature for 3 min at 13,000 rpm to generate a clear fat layer (for fat tissues) and a supernatant.

steps.title: Transfer clear homogenate
steps.instruction: Tilt the tube at a 45° angle and carefully transfer the clear homogenate (avoid the upper white material) into a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add ethanol and load column
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl ethanol to each tube (50 % ethanol for liver tissues, 70 % ethanol for fat tissues). Mix immediately by pipetting and transfer the mixture to an RNAeasy spin column (max 700 µl, provided in the RNAeasy Mini kit).

steps.title: First spin of column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 30 seconds at 10,000 rpm at room temperature. Discard the flow‑through into a 50 ml collection tube.

steps.title: Second spin of column
steps.instruction: Apply the remaining lysate to the same column and centrifuge again for 30 seconds at 10,000 rpm at room temperature. Discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First RW1 wash
steps.instruction: Add 350 µl RW1 buffer (provided in the kit) to the column using a fresh tip for each sample.

steps.title: Centrifuge after RW1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 10,000 rpm at room temperature and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: DNase I treatment
steps.instruction: Add 80 µl DNase I working solution (Qiagen, RNase‑free, Catalog #79254) directly onto the membrane (drop in the middle).

steps.title: Incubate DNase I
steps.instruction: Incubate the column at room temperature for 15 minutes (use a fresh tip for each sample).

steps.title: Second RW1 wash
steps.instruction: Add another 350 µl RW1 buffer to each column.

steps.title: Centrifuge after second RW1
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 10,000 rpm at room temperature and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: First RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl RPE buffer (provided in the kit) to each column.

steps.title: Centrifuge after first RPE
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 seconds at 10,000 rpm at room temperature and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Second RPE wash
steps.instruction: Add another 500 µl RPE buffer to each column.

steps.title: Extended RPE spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 2 minutes at 10,000 rpm at room temperature, discard the flow‑through, and place the column into a new collection tube.

steps.title: High‑speed dry spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 1 minute at 13,200 rpm at room temperature to remove residual buffer.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and add RNase‑free water (provided with the RNAeasy Mini kit) directly onto the membrane: 30 µl for sWAT, GON, and liver samples.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 1 minute at 10,000 rpm at room temperature (use a fresh tip for each sample) to collect the RNA eluate.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Keep the DNA‑free total RNA samples on ice and measure concentration with a Nanodrop 2000C (Isogen Life Science).

steps.title: Dilute liver RNA
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 ng/µl dilution of the DNA‑free total RNA liver samples using RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Reverse transcription cycling
steps.instruction: Place the diluted samples in a 2720 Thermal Cycler (Applied Biosystems) and run: 10 min at 25 °C, 60 min at 48 °C, 5 min at 95 °C, then hold at +4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare RT‑PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction combine: 5 µl TaqMan Fast Universal PCR Master Mix (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Ref. 4364103), 0.5 µl TaqMan gene‑specific assay, 2.5 µl RNase‑free water, and 2 µl cDNA. Use appropriate filter tips (VWR 20 µl, 200 µl, 1000 µl, 10 µl).

steps.title: Load qPCR plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the 8 µl reaction mix into each well of a 96‑well plate, add the cDNA, seal the plate, and keep at +4 °C for same‑day runs or store at –20 °C (run within 5 days).

steps.title: Run qPCR
steps.instruction: Run the plate on a 7500 Fast RT‑PCR System (Applied Biosystems) with the program: 95 °C 20 sec, then 40 cycles of 95 °C 3 sec and 60 °C 30 sec.

steps.title: Export Ct data
steps.instruction: Transfer the generated Ct values to an Excel spreadsheet.

steps.title: Calculate ΔCt values
steps.instruction: For each gene, average the Ct values across replicates, then compute ΔCt = Ct(gene) – Ct(β‑actin).

steps.title: Calculate ΔΔCt and fold change
steps.instruction: Average ΔCt of the calibrator (wild‑type mice) for each gene, then compute ΔΔCt = ΔCt(experimental) – ΔCt(calibrator). Finally calculate fold change = 2^(‑ΔΔCt).
